Projects

Personal projects that combine healthcare knowledge with data skills.

MID: Medicines Information Dataset Analysis

Personal project · Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX
  • Cleaned and standardised a 192K-record, 15-column medicine dataset and worked on a 4,449-record sample.
  • Converted unstructured label text into 9 linked tables using Power Query.
  • Built a star schema data model in Power Pivot with DAX measures: Habit-Forming %, Pregnancy-Unsafe % and Average Side Effects per Medicine.
  • Designed a 3-page interactive Excel dashboard with slicers and KPI cards covering drug classes, side effects and safety risks.
3.3%of medicines are habit-forming (sample of 4,449)
58.5%labelled unsafe or possibly unsafe in pregnancy (sample of 4,449)
7.5average side effects per medicine (sample of 4,449)

Medicines Information Dashboard: Overview

Overview of all 4,449 cleaned records. Slicers filter by dosage form, therapeutic class and habit-forming status. The charts compare medicine counts by class, single versus combination products, and dosage forms.

Watch screen recording

Medicines Information Dashboard: Class deep dive

Shows what each therapeutic class treats, which side effects it causes and which active ingredients it contains, with mechanism-of-action breakdowns.

Watch screen recording

Medicines Information Dashboard: Safety and risk

Shows what labels say about pregnancy, kidney, liver, alcohol and driving cautions, with average risk flags per therapeutic class.

Watch screen recording

Click a screenshot to enlarge it. Built for educational analysis only, not medical advice. The analysis uses a sample of the full 192K-row dataset.

What I found

  • Only 3.3% of the 4,449 medicines in the sample are labelled habit-forming.
  • 58.5% are labelled unsafe or possibly unsafe in pregnancy.
  • A typical medicine in the sample lists 7.5 side effects.
